body:
### Wails version family

v3

### Exact Wails version

v3.0.0-beta.19+

### Operating System

macOS

### Description

After updating to beta.19+ I am unable to open the web inspector from inside my app.
I add the EXTRA_TAGS=private_mac_apis

### To Reproduce

1. add 
    ```go
     if envInfo.Debug {
		menu.Add("Open DevTools").OnClick(func(ctx *application.Context) {
			window.OpenDevTools()
		})
    }
    ```
2. started with `EXTRA_TAGS=private_mac_apis wails3 dev`
3. Click the menu entry

Nothing will happen

### Expected behaviour

Web inspector will show up.
